title: AIROOT Error Response
description: The document the CLI prints when a command cannot answer, whatever the command was. One shape covers every registered reason code (measured: all 96 produce these keys). `evidence` here is the short human-readable line, the same form doctor-response uses on a diagnostic; the structured {kind, detail} object that common.$defs.evidence defines belongs to documents that report findings, not to the failure of one command.
